title: Input Group
description: Inputs joined to their prefix, suffix and add-ons, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Field, Button and Spinner primitives: a store address behind an https:// prefix, a price between a $ prefix and a USD suffix, a read-only API key with a Copy button, and a product search with a Search button. Each add-on shares the input's edge and radius, and turns red with it when the field is invalid. Responds to its container (@container) — the heading steps up at @md while the fields go two-up, and the heading moves beside the fields at @lg — and renders its default, empty, disabled, loading and error states from props.
